title: Guidepoint Launches Guidepoint360 Mobile App with AI-Driven Research Assistant
summary: Guidepoint launched the Guidepoint360 mobile app featuring AskGP, an AI assistant that surfaces cited answers from expert transcripts, plus real-time alerts, streamlined scheduling, and enterprise-grade compliance controls.
whyItMatters: Mobile app launch signals Guidepoint's investment in client self-service and on-demand expert access.
